changes: Buffered first-row predictor kernels, omitted previous buffer for one-row images, and no last-row swap.
Streaming first-row kernels, omitted previous buffer for single-row passes, and no last-row swap.
Adaptive first rows skip Up/Paeth because their bytes/scores duplicate earlier None/Sub candidates; strict-score tie order is preserved.

pipeline.minimum: Outputs below 4096 filtered bytes use at least 2048 iterations. See each TSV iteration column.
pipeline.allocations: Separate untimed probe of complete PNG APIs: allocation calls, reallocations and requested bytes.

fixtures: Grayscale8, RGBA8, RGBA16 and packed grayscale2; 4097x1 and 33x9, plain/Adam7, all six filters. Native 513x257 None/adaptive controls and RGBA8 1x1 all-filter plain/Adam7 cases. Both buffered and writer encodes. Stored compression isolates reconstruction and checksums; no Fast throughput claim.
answers: Every process checks complete scalar-modeled filtered bytes from independent test support, then complete decoded native samples. Both filtered fingerprints and per-version allocation counts are checked. Linked caller also requires complete old/new buffered PNGs and writer PNGs to match byte-for-byte.

linked.batches: One warmup plus eleven retained alternating batches per version; median per version, then median across three processes.
linked.iterations: 512 for width below 100, 128 for wide single rows, 6 for tall controls.
linked.memory: 50 untimed writer-owned peak-buffer probes per process, separately verified stable and nonincreasing. Timed writer calls blackbox both returned EncodeStats and output bytes.

identity: Local measure.py and pair.py retain source/harness/build/profile/executable/log/output hashes. measure.py touches source timestamps before building and requires an actual library rebuild, preventing stale Cargo artifacts after source restoration. Caller build-log names include -caller-build to avoid collisions. Recorded measurement files are immutable.
machine: Windows QueryThreadCycleTime; logical CPU 2 affinity; existing optimized/LTO bench profile. This task serializes builds, timings and correctness checks. Host workloads, cache state and CPU frequency are uncontrolled.
validation: Encoder filter-byte/native-format/reference/boundary/field and writer/deflate tests, PNG streaming/static/APNG recovery/resource checks, plus release/debug library oracles, strict all-target Clippy and scoped formatting. Independent integration/support/fixture/oracle inputs remain unchanged; the existing scalar unit oracle additionally verifies first-row bytes and scores in scored/unscored modes.
metric_changes: Encoder-owned memory statistics truthfully decrease where the previous row is omitted. No public API, production dependency or unsafe-code change.
